Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that “country of literature” was a poetic label for Germany and equated “border troops” with the Bundesgrenzschutz, instead of following the likely Wikidata-style property chain: Rainer Ernst’s country of citizenship → German Democratic Republic (East Germany) → literature of that country (East German literature) → border troops of that country (Border Troops of the GDR), which are from East Germany. This misinterpretation led to the wrong country.
